task.title: Installing and creating a username for Splunk
task.shortdesc: To prepare Splunk for Red Hat Quay action log storage, you can install Splunk Enterprise and create an administrator username and password.

step.cmd: Create a Splunk account by navigating to Splunk and entering the required credentials.
Navigate to the Splunk EnterpriseFree Trial page, select your platform and installation package, and then click Download Now.
Install the Splunk software on your machine. When prompted, create a username, for example, splunk_admin and password.
After creating a username and password, a localhost URL will be provided for your Splunk deployment, for example, http://<sample_url>.remote.csb:8000/. Open the URL in your preferred browser.
Log in with the username and password you created during installation. You are directed to the Splunk UI.
